# Pinned deployment tool

`deployer-7.5.12.phar` is the unmodified official Deployer v7.5.12 release.
Source: https://github.com/deployphp/deployer/releases/tag/v7.5.12
Official asset ID: `230685193` (`deployer.phar`).
SHA-256: `b55c6609653e888c672d327c407f8bba6324b9c9cc24f9dcfb3f4b3922760632`.
The upstream MIT notice is retained in `deployer-LICENSE`.

The exact-SHA checkout supplies these bytes to both deployment jobs. Each job
checks the existing pinned digest before use, without a release-server download.
To update the tool, replace the official bytes, version and digest together.
